text: This report outlines proposed changes to Zoning By-law 569-2013 (‘the city-wide Zoning By-law’) to simplify and modernize low-rise residential zoning regulations. The proposed changes seek to remove barriers, ease administration, and enable the creation of more housing as part of the Housing Action Plan to achieve or exceed the provincial housing target of 285,000 new homes over the next 10 years. These proposed changes will form the basis for public consultation later in 2023.
